metrics.layer_count_definition: Nondecreasing receiving-body/root support courses; not hanging-tip bottomZ or slicing layers.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.scope: Occupied8mm/4.8mm source sample andwhole-part palette projectedonto the same normalizedbody. Excludes studs,gaps,chamfers andsupports; realCGmustbeviewed separately.

front.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

side.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

painted_feature_region.interpretation: Nearest source palette labels on actual registered visible surfaces. Face pose, color regions and gaps influence this statistic; it does not declare likeness approval.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.region_definition: Tight reference-front bbox of all non-base colorcells plus5pixels; not automatic anatomical landmark detection.
descriptive_pattern_metrics.interpretation: Differences are descriptive. Morepieces are not a validated likeness percentage or mechanical completion.

front.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
front.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

three_quarter.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
three_quarter.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

limitations_ja: 倍率は実部品数で、寸法倍率ではありません。比較1xは本人不在時の暫定前提です。
元3MFの実塗色面と左右面を参照し、全実部品を鏡対応へ改訂しています。初期C/1x基準の不対称は未変更の参考として別に表示します。
放射状分解は説明図。物理的に衝突せず分解できる保証ではありません。下からの順序は公称支持の検査で、保持力は未確認です。
元の本体内の実部品を一体の受け・根元へ再構成し、外付け/仮の組立支台を不要とする候補です。実CADの接触・挿入・断面・全荷重prefixを検査済みですが、現物保持力や印刷時サポート不要は未確認です。
左右対称化のため旧案の格子形状・配色を意図して変更した新revisionです。旧案の形・色が不変という証拠は転用していません。
limitations_en: The multiplier is actual physicalpiececount, not linearsize. The1xbaseline is a provisional creator assumption while the user was unavailable.
Original3MF painted surfaces and its intrinsic reflection plane guide this actual paired-part revision. InitialC/1x retain their known asymmetry as unchanged references.
Radial explosion is explanatory, not collision-free physical disassembly. Bottom-up order has nominal support checks, not verified retention.

Existing body material is joined into real seated internal supports, with no external or temporary assembly stands. Native contact/insertion/sections/all nominal load prefixes are checked; physical retention and slicer-support requirements remain unvalidated.
This distinct bilateral revision intentionally changes prior cell geometry and paint; old unchanged-shape/color claims are not reused.

assembly_support.method: Paired actual whole-color material roots and reused native footprint supports; intentional symmetric body/color changes are bound separately from their mechanical baseline

observations_ja: 実26,734部品/231型、固定分母17,873・目標26,810との差-76。既存の1.2倍/3倍固定案や旧原本を変更しない新しい対称revisionとして確認した。
正面/斜め/登録正面/放射分解の実CG4枚と等倍率の左右眼拡大を閲覧した。黄色い眼は鏡対応する同一形状/寸法/位置、青い顔・ゴーグル・紫枠・側部も対称な実形状である。格子の段差、角度・照明の差、美的採用の判断は別問題として保留している。
元/別展開FreeCADの全26,734ID/type/color/pose/stepが一致し、実213型/回転ペアのBRep両向きcut体積差は全て0。全partの鏡対応bijective/involutive・色・実poseを検査した。セル図や割合だけを根拠にしていない。
最初のnative支持不足を、同色の実荷重部品の一体化と実際の受け面/接点拡張で修正した。全34支持・510荷重prefixは実CAD体積/重心と非reset token台帳で合格、最小公称margin2.380178317mm。単一solid、屋根、実断面、非干渉、挿入と全先行関係も確認し、元71必須対象→34実検査部品のlineageを維持した。
実の外部/仮組立支台は0。単独で同色経路を持たない孤立した青1cellの左右3対は実周囲の紫へ明示統合し、黄色眼/占有形は維持した。内部受けの色変更も意図差分と新mechanical baselineに結合し、旧版の全色変更0という主張は転用していない。
単一サンプルの診断ラスタでは継ぎ目付近の1画素に材質aliasが生じたため、その失敗画像/記録を保存し、元sceneを変更せず診断だけ32サンプルで再描画した。判定の1pixel境界距離は緩めていない。CAD/通常CG4/動画を再生成・左右反転していない。
最終の実無照明材質マスクは左右眼各8,855pixels、bounds65x146px、眼mirror XOR0/境界差0。全silhouette XOR200・共通占有部のmaterial XOR30は全て宣言済み1pixel境界距離内であり、全画像差0とは報告していない。全nativeBRep/pose/colorの実対称性は別途差0で確認した。
実144frame/12fps/12秒/3章動画の1/18/54/73/108/144と、実courseから選んだ76/77/78、112/113/114、134/135/136をデコード閲覧した。最初のrootは真底面11.2mm、受け20.8mm、step382であり、表示順のために実Zを偽装していない。
保存sceneの全26,734instance/材質/pose/stepとframe1/54/72/73/144/1の評価位置が一致し、空→全数と絶対放射往復も確認した。Mona/Ducky・1x・既固定案・元geometry/scene/通常PNG/MP4は保持。現物PLA/infill質量、保持力、強度、動的荷重、スライサー支持材は未確認で、印刷承認は保留。
observations_en: This additive symmetric revision contains26,734actual parts/231types, difference-76 from the fixed26,810target/17,873denominator. Existing fixed1.2x/3xcases and all prior originals remain unchanged.

All four actual CG views and equal-scale eye crops were inspected. Yellow eye geometry/dimensions/positions, blue face/goggles, purple frame and side geometry correspond under reflection. Grid stepping, perspective/lighting and human aesthetic selection are separate limitations.

Original and relocated FreeCAD agree on all26,734IDs/types/colors/poses/steps. Every213actual native type/rotation pair has zero bidirectional BRep cut-volume difference, with complete color/pose-preserving mirror bijection/involution. This is not a cell-only or similarity-percentage verdict.

Measured static failures were corrected using real same-color material unions and receiving-face/contact extensions. All34supports/510native volume-centroid nonreset-token prefixes pass at minimum nominal margin2.380178317mm, including true solids/roofs/sections/noninterference/insertion/predecessors. All71mandatory source targets map to34real checked parts without omissions.

There are zero actual external or temporary assembly stands. Three isolated one-cell blue mirror pairs without a usable same-color route were explicitly merged into surrounding purple material, preserving yellow eyes and occupied geometry. Internal receiving-color changes are bound to the new baseline and intentional-change record; old unchanged-color claims are not reused.

A single-sample diagnostic raster produced one isolated seam/material alias. Its exact failed image/evidence were preserved, then only the diagnostic mask was rerendered at32samples from the unchanged native scene. The1pixel boundary-distance gate was not widened. Native CAD, ordinaryCG4 and movie were not regenerated or image-mirrored.

The final actual unlit mask has8,855pixels per eye,65x146bounds,eyeXOR0 and eye boundarydifference0. Whole-silhouetteXOR200 and common-occupancy materialXOR30 are all within the predeclared1pixel raster boundary distance; they are not falsely called zero-image difference. Actual native BRep/pose/color reflection independently has zero difference.

The real144-frame/12fps/12-second/three-chapter movie was decoded at1/18/54/73/108/144 and actual course samples76-78,112-114,134-136. The first root retains true bottom11.2mm, receiver20.8mm andstep382; physicalZ was not falsified for presentation.

Savedscene26,734instances/materials/poses/steps and evaluatedframes1/54/72/73/144/1 agree, including empty-to-full and absolute radial return. Mona/Ducky/1x/fixedcases and originalnative/scene/ordinaryPNG/MP4 remain preserved. Physical PLA/infill mass, retention, strength, dynamic loads and slicer supports remain untested; printing stays on hold.
